scenario_name: Add Item form opens with mandatory fields marked
expected_result: The Add Item dialog opens with SKU Code, Type, Category, SKU Description, UOM and Minimum Stock marked mandatory

scenario_name: SKU Code is auto-generated and read-only
expected_result: SKU Code is read-only and the form says it is auto-generated and unique

scenario_name: Type offers Domestic, Export and POS
expected_result: The Type dropdown lists Domestic, Export and POS

scenario_name: CBM is calculated from length, width and height
expected_result: CBM is populated automatically (30 x 20 x 10 cm = 0.006 m3) once length, width and height are entered

scenario_name: Save with every field empty is rejected
expected_result: 'Category is required' and 'SKU Description is required' are shown and nothing is saved
'SKU Description is required' is shown and the item is not saved; the form stays open
'Category is required' is shown and the item is not saved; the form stays open
A required-field message is shown for Unit Price and the item is not saved; the form stays open
A required-field message is shown for UOM and the item is not saved; the form stays open
A required-field message is shown for Minimum Stock and the item is not saved; the form stays open

scenario_name: Letters are refused in a number field
expected_result: Minimum Stock refuses letters: the field stays empty and 'Minimum Stock is required' is shown

scenario_name: Create an item with all mandatory fields
expected_result: 'Item Added Successfully' is shown and the item is listed; it is then deleted
'Item Updated Successfully' is shown and the new description is listed

scenario_name: Cancelling a delete keeps the item

steps.value: Are you sure you want to delete this item?

expected_result: After Cancel on the delete confirmation the item remains listed

scenario_name: Cancel closes the Add form without saving
expected_result: The dialog closes and no item is created

scenario_name: Markup in SKU Description is stored as plain text
expected_result: The markup is shown as literal text and no script runs

scenario_name: Search narrows the list to matching items
expected_result: Searching for a value no item has displays 'No items found'

scenario_name: Item list shows its columns and paging
expected_result: The list displays its main columns and a 'Showing 1 to 10 of N entries' pager
